architectural_fidelity.reason: Same room structure preserved: window position on right wall maintained, ceiling height consistent, white crown molding intact, same camera viewpoint, side gray walls present, radiator cover location preserved under window

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with no ghost outlines, remnants or phantom shadows; floor is clean slate ready for new staging

style_commitment.reason: Strong Art Deco commitment: dramatic black and gold Chinoiserie wallpaper with branching metallic pattern, emerald green gallery rail with extensive framed art collection, dark sophisticated palette with metallic accents—unmistakably period-specific styling, not generic neutral

editorial_density.reason: Room is essentially empty except for wall treatment; no furniture, no layered textiles, no rugs, no plants, no table lamps or floor lamps, no styling vignettes—this is architectural finish work, not Architectural Digest-level editorial staging with lived-in details

photorealism.reason: Realistic lighting with proper shadows, wallpaper texture appears dimensional and authentic, flooring material reads as genuine wood with natural variation, no CGI/plastic feel, coherent light sources from ceiling and window

designer_preference_reason: Collov delivers complete, client-ready rooms with furniture, textiles, and styling that clients can visualize living in, while Cova shows only empty architectural finishes requiring additional conceptualization
what_cova_does_better: Dramatic, authentic Art Deco wallpaper treatment with museum-quality Chinoiserie pattern
Bold color commitment with emerald gallery rail and sophisticated dark palette
Cohesive architectural detailing with extensive framed art collection creating gallery wall effect
what_collov_does_better: Complete room furnishing with bed, nightstands, seating, and area rugs
Editorial-level layered textiles including bedding, throws, and pillows in multiple textures
Lived-in styling density with plants, table lamps, floor lamps, books, and decorative vignettes
Client-ready visualization showing actual functional room layout
specific_fixes_if_failing: Add luxury Art Deco furniture: velvet channel-tufted sofa in jewel tone, brass and marble coffee table, sculptural accent chairs
Layer minimum 3-4 textile elements: geometric Art Deco area rug, silk velvet pillows, metallic throw blankets
Add editorial styling details: geometric table lamps with brass finish, large sculptural plant (bird of paradise or fiddle leaf fig), decorative books, metallic accessories
Include multiple light sources: Art Deco floor lamp, picture lights on gallery wall, table lamps creating ambient layers
